headline: Launcher mod installs expand as Going Commando matching advances
summary: OpenRAC development gains signed-index mod installs, dependencies and rollback, plus Windows sound fixes, phone graphics work and object/free-camera inspection; the mod-install work still lacks Windows, macOS and Android runs. The stable branch takes a targeted PAL level 11 lighting-bake fix rather than its usual release pull request, while lighting issues OpenRAC#159 and OpenRAC#173 close. Going Commando ends at 84.74% of USA v1.01 code bytes matched, while its native port remains an unmerged, not-yet-playable draft; the original game's fully matched source gets extensive contributor cleanup and Deadlocked gains PAL reconstructions. Archipelago v2.1.0 protects save-slot room identity, difficulty v1.2.4 repairs Blarg Station landings, and item-randomizer v1.0.4 also releases against the newly released Mod SDK 1.11.0. Players are asked to help test randomizer item requirements in openrac-mods#25; co-op remains a draft.
